questions.cardText:
[Mathematics] What does the Goldbach Conjecture propose?
A. There are infinitely many prime numbers
B. Zeros of the Riemann zeta function lie on a critical line
C. Any even number greater than 2 is the sum of two prime numbers
Answer: C. As one of the oldest unsolved problems in number theory and all of mathematics, it has been tested with ever-increasing numbers.
questions.de: Als was lässt sich nach der Goldbachschen Vermutung jede gerade Zahl größer als 2 schreiben?
questions.en: According to Goldbach's conjecture, what can every even integer greater than 2 be written as?

timeline.labelEn: Christian Goldbach writes to Leonhard Euler the letter that gives rise to Goldbach's conjecture
timeline.labelDe: Christian Goldbach schreibt Leonhard Euler den Brief, aus dem die Goldbachsche Vermutung hervorgeht

questions.notes: Goldbach's letter (7 June 1742) stated a related form about sums of three primes; the even-number form comes from Euler's reply of 30 June 1742. Still unproven. Option A is Euclid's theorem, B the Riemann hypothesis.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] In which of the following countries can you find a pink lake?
A. Australia
B. Bangladesh
C. Chile
Answer: A. Lake Hillier in Australia is famous for its vibrant pink color, caused by the presence of certain algae and bacteria.
questions.de: Wie heißt der leuchtend rosafarbene See auf Middle Island vor der Südküste Westaustraliens?
questions.en: What is the name of the vibrant pink lake on Middle Island, off the south coast of Western Australia?

timeline.labelEn: Matthew Flinders' expedition visits Lake Hillier, giving the first written record of the pink lake
timeline.labelDe: Matthew Flinders' Expedition besucht den Lake Hillier – die erste schriftliche Erwähnung des rosa Sees

questions.notes: Colour attributed to the alga Dunaliella salina plus red halophilic bacteria in the salt crusts (Wikipedia). 'Which country' is not unique (pink lakes also exist e.g. in Senegal), so the open question names the lake. The pink has faded at times after heavy rain.
